name: geqo_threshold
description: Sets the minimum number of FROM items in a query that triggers use of the Genetic Query Optimizer (GEQO) instead of the standard exhaustive search planner.
symptoms: Excessively long query planning times for complex joins
Suboptimal query plans for large join queries
Increased CPU usage during planning phase
Query timeouts during planning for multi-table joins
tuning_tips: Increase this value to defer GEQO activation for more complex queries where exhaustive planning remains feasible; decrease only if planning time dominates execution time for moderately joined queries and GEQO yields better plans.
